methods.acceptance_yield: paired risk difference; repositories sampled first and intact pairs sampled within selected repositories
methods.binding: S05 LOW binding AND not S05 HIGH AND named non-S05 HIGH binding
methods.domain_dependent: qualified heterogeneous repository/task effects cannot be overridden by pooling
methods.interactions: condition effects by repository and task class; difficulty retained
methods.migration: binding conjunction plus manipulation, controls, adequate power and primary threshold
methods.mixed_effects: repository is outer resampling unit; paired templates remain intact within repositories; repository-by-task strata retain difficulty
methods.multiplicity: Holm adjustment of repository-cluster sharp-null LOW/HIGH randomization p-values; ordinary bootstrap draws are never used as null p-values
methods.throughput: accepted all-gates per 480 active minutes; repository-then-pair hierarchical cluster bootstrap
methods.time_to_valid: tie-grouped Kaplan-Meier restricted mean through 480 minutes; events applied before same-time censor removal
methods.uncertainty: two-sided percentile 95% intervals from 10,000 deterministic hierarchical repository/pair resamples

no_silent_fallback: Any unavailable or malformed required method raises an error; no simpler substitute is permitted.
null_inference: 10,000 fixed-seed repository-cluster LOW/HIGH assignment swaps under the sharp null with add-one Monte Carlo p-values
unit: paired template cluster nested in repository and crossed with task class/difficulty
